title: Tunisian Tagine Chicken
description: A traditional North African dish featuring chicken cooked in a flavorful tagine with tunisian spices. This recipe serves 4 and is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most middle eastern markets

ingredients.name: Warm spices
ingredients.notes: Ground cinnamon, ground ginger, ground cumin

ingredients.name: Tagine
ingredients.notes: A clay or ceramic pot with a conical lid

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the tagine and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tunisian spice blend and warm spices to the tagine and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine with the conical lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the crumbled cheese and continue to bake for an additional 5-10 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
